contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver. Coin. Commemorative denarius for Vespasian (69-79), issue under Titus of AD 80-81, mint of Rome, RIC volume 2 no 59(a), Reece period 4. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: DIVUS AVGVSTVS VESPASIANVS (retrograde). Reverse description: Victory advancing left attaching shield to trophy with mourning captive seated left at its base.
